title: Toward Inclusive Educational AI: Auditing Frontier LLMs through a Multiplexity Lens
findings: Baseline LLMs exhibit a strong Western-centric and secular bias, with minimal representation of the Islamic perspective. A cited study noted GPT-3's 'persistent anti-muslim bias'. The proposed 'Multiplexity' framework, particularly the Multi-Agent System (MAS) which includes a dedicated 'Islamic Agent', significantly increases the representation and positive sentiment towards the Islamic cultural perspective, achieving a more balanced and pluralistic output.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the representation of different cultural and intellectual traditions, including the 'Islamic' perspective, in LLM responses to educational questions. It assesses cultural polarization and bias against non-Western, non-secular viewpoints, which includes religious and spiritual dimensions inspired by Islamic epistemology.
